sources.title: Rasayan Labs — AI OS for Drug Discovery
sources.snippet: Rasayan is the AI operating system for pharmaceutical R&D — retrosynthesis, impurity prediction, ADMET/PK, patent search, molecular docking, OCSR, and chemistry-aware document intelligence in one platform. 105 AI models. 1.3T+ screensable molecules.

sources.title: IISc Releases SraVaani Voice AI Model - GKToday
sources.snippet: The model covers 20 scheduled Indian languages and 45 regional languages, including Garo, Angika, Chakma, Kokborok, Tulu, Bundeli, and Bajjika. The system supports 10 scripts and includes automatic language identification.
